item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 6, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A gold 'sponge' enhances optical behavior, this week's photonics business headlines, and nonlinear metasurfaces convert infrared light to visible.

item.title: PODCAST: Interview with Travis Wood, president of Lattice Materials
item.description: Episode 89 of Following the Photons: A Photonics Podcast features Travis Wood, president of Lattice Materials.

item.title: The Ring-Core Mode Laser Revolution
item.description: The ring-core laser is used with high-power IR welding lasers for deep, spatter-free welds and in additive manufacturing. Analysis of key characteristics are vital, such as ring and core diameters, power distribution ratios between ring and core, and roundness.

item.title: Photonics, FSMs, & Nanopositioning
item.description: See the latest advances in active photonics alignment, fast steering mirrors for space communication/beam control, and nanopositioning systems, including U.S.-manufactured direct-drive stages, 6-axis hexapods, and piezo stages for quantum applications.

item.title: Metasurface holograms enable ‘optical lock’
item.description: Inspired by diffractive deep neural networks, researchers create a metasurface hologram ‘optical lock’ that reveals its image/message only under the correct physical setup.

item.title: Appotronics Unveils the Near-Future of AR Glasses Display at SPIE Photonics West: Founder's Vision
item.description: At SPIE Photonics West, Appotronics founder, chairman, and CEO Li Yi shares the company's unique offering: a single optical engine to enable binocular display for AR glasses. He recalls Appotronics' two-decade journey from developing ALPD technology to applying its lasers across cinema, home entertainment, professional AV, automobiles, and AR, highlighting its Shenzhen-based manufacturing and innovation.

item.title: G&H Photonics: From Components to Real-World Systems
item.description: See how G&H Photonics transforms precision photonic components into real-world systems—combining vertically integrated expertise and product engineering to deliver scalable, deployment-ready solutions.

item.title: Appotronics' Optical Engines: Empowering AR Glasses Makers
item.description: Chen Menghao, General Manager of the Appotronics Innovation Center, introduces pioneering miniature optical engines for AR glasses: the Dragonfly G1 Mini, the Dragonfly C1, and a laser+LCOS prototype. These enable compact, cost-effective green or full-color binocular displays, helping to overcome key industry roadblocks.

item.title: Cross-layer all-optical physiology permits neuron circuit mapping
item.description: Cross-layer all-optical physiology provides an essential tool for directly probing functional connectivity and causal interactions within neuronal circuits—and achieves high-speed, cross-layer two-photon imaging and optogenetics.

item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 13, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A terahertz wave-based method shows promise for wireless comms, this week's photonics news roundup, and optical frequency combs could enhance radio telescopes.
